shortDescription: Configure Active Directory groups to be used with Directory Services

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: certificate_file
options.description: Provide the full path of the SSL certificate. The certificate should be a Root CA Certificate encoded in Base64 format. This is applicable when I(validate_certificate) is C(true).

options.name: domain_controller_lookup
options.description: Select the Domain Controller Lookup method.

options.name: domain_controller_port
options.description: Domain controller port. By default, Global Catalog Address port number 3269 is populated. For the Domain Controller Access, enter 636 as the port number. C(NOTE), Only LDAPS ports are supported.

options.name: domain_password
options.description: Provide the domain password. This is applicable when I(test_connection) is C(true).

options.name: domain_server
options.description: Enter the domain name or FQDN or IP address of the domain controller. If I(domain_controller_lookup) is C(DNS), enter the domain name to query DNS for the domain controllers. If I(domain_controller_lookup) is C(MANUAL), enter the FQDN or the IP address of the domain controller. The maximum number of Active Directory servers that can be added is three.

options.name: domain_username
options.description: Provide the domain username either in the UPN (username@domain) or NetBIOS (domain\\username) format. This is applicable when I(test_connection) is C(true).

options.name: group_domain
options.description: Provide the group domain in the format C(example.com) or C(ou=org, dc=example, dc=com).

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular IP address or hostname.

options.name: id
options.description: Provide the ID of the existing Active Directory service connection. This is applicable for modification and deletion. This is mutually exclusive with I(name).

options.name: name
options.description: Provide a name for the Active Directory connection. This is applicable for creation and deletion. This is mutually exclusive with I(name).

options.name: network_timeout
options.description: Enter the network timeout duration in seconds. The supported timeout duration range is 15 to 300 seconds.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: port
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular HTTPS port.

options.name: search_timeout
options.description: Enter the search timeout duration in seconds. The supported timeout duration range is 15 to 300 seconds.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) allows to create or modify an Active Directory service. C(absent) allows to delete a Active Directory service.

options.name: test_connection
options.description: Enables testing the connection to the domain controller. The connection to the domain controller is tested with the provided Active Directory service details. If test fails, module will error out. If C(true), I(domain_username) and I(domain_password) has to be provided.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certificate
options.description: Enables validation of SSL certificate of the domain controller. The module will always report change when this is C(true).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
